info.description: Schedule and booking API for dance and ballet schools.
info.title: Studio Schedule API

get.description: Returns every account with its person, ordered by email.

post.description: Signs the admin in as another account ("login as") for at most one hour and sets the session cookie; the admin's own session ends. Recorded in the audit log. Admins cannot be impersonated (403); a disabled or unconfirmed account is a 409.

get.description: Returns the persons enrolled in a class, ordered by family and given name.
get.summary: List the members of a class

get.description: Returns the persons whose given name, family name or email contains every word of `q`, ignoring case, ordered by family and given name; at most 50. For the office's pickers, e.g. linking a staff member to a person.

parameters.description: Words to look for; empty matches everyone.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Words to look for; empty matches everyone.

post.description: Adds a person without an account, e.g. a second parent or a staff member's record.

delete.description: Deletes a person, e.g. one created by mistake. While anything refers to it (an account, a staff link, bookings, class memberships, or a guardian link in either direction) that is a 409 `in-use` and nothing changes.

get.description: Returns every field of a person with its guardians, dependents, account, linked staff members and class memberships.

put.description: Replaces every field of a person, including the email and the office's notes. The email of the person's account, its login name, stays as it is.

post.description: Creates an unconfirmed account without a password for an existing person and mails it an invitation, whose link (valid for 72 hours) sets the password and confirms the account. A person with an account is a 409 `has-account`, an email another account has a 409 `duplicate`. Only an admin may create an admin account; for the office that is a 403.
post.summary: Create an account for a person

post.description: Links a guardian to the person, e.g. a second parent. A guardian linked already is a 409 `duplicate`; an unknown guardian, the person itself, or one of its dependents (directly or through others, which would make the links a cycle) is a 422 on `guardianId`.

delete.description: Ends a guardianship. The person stays, even without a guardian left; a guardian who is not linked is a 404.

get.description: Returns every staff member ordered by display name, including former (inactive) staff and the link to a person, which the public `listStaff` leaves out.
Returns the weekly classes of a term like `listClasses`, including retired classes, which the public list leaves out.
get.summary: List all classes of a term

post.description: Confirms the email address with the token from the confirmation link and the account's password, and signs in. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410.

parameters.description: Session cookie, if any; it ends on success.
parameters.name: studio_session

schema.description: Session cookie, if any; it ends on success.

post.description: Checks the password (a wrong one is a 422 on body.password) and mails a confirmation link to the new address; the account keeps its address until the link is used. The answer is the same if the new address already has an account (then no mail is sent). Refused (403) while an admin is signed in as the account.
Moves the account to the new address with the token from the link and mails a notice to the old address. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410; an address taken in the meantime is a 409.
Ends an impersonation and signs the admin in again with a new session cookie. A 409 if the session is no impersonation.

put.description: Sets the language of the mails the account receives; without a locale the school's default applies.

post.description: Signs in with email and password and sets the session cookie. A wrong email or password is a 401; a correct password for an unconfirmed email is a 403. Too many attempts per client or wrong passwords per email are a 429 with Retry-After.

parameters.description: Session cookie, if any; it ends on success.
parameters.name: studio_session

schema.description: Session cookie, if any; it ends on success.

post.description: Ends the session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns the signed-in account, or 401 without a valid session. While an admin is signed in as the account, impersonator names the admin.

post.description: Replaces the password after checking the current one (a wrong one is a 422 on body.currentPassword) and ends every other session of the account. Refused (403) while an admin is signed in as the account.
Mails a link to set a new password to the address if it belongs to an account that may sign in. The answer is the same for every address. Too many mail requests per client are a 429 with Retry-After.
Sets the password with the token from the reset link and ends every session of the account; it does not sign in. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410.
post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

post.description: Creates a member account and mails a confirmation link to the email address. The answer is the same whether the address is new or already registered. Too many mail requests per client are a 429 with Retry-After.

delete.description: Deletes a class with its lessons while none of them has started or been booked and it has no members; otherwise it is a 409 `in-use` and can be retired instead.

put.description: Replaces the fields of a class; its term stays. The future lessons that were not edited one by one follow, with their bookings; a capacity below the bookings of one of them is a 422 on `capacity`. A retired class generates no more lessons and leaves the public timetable; its future lessons that still follow it and have no bookings are deleted.

post.description: Enrolls a person in a class. An unknown person is a 422 on `personId`, a person who is a member already a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Ends a person's membership in a class; a person who is not a member is a 404.

get.description: Returns all course types (dance styles) ordered by name.

post.description: Adds a course type. A name another course type has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Deletes a course type that no class or lesson uses; a used one is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and description of a course type; its classes and lessons show the new name. A name another course type has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Lists fictional demo accounts, one per role, with their password. Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.
Lists the newest mails of the outbox, so that the demo, which delivers no mail, can show them (e.g. the confirmation link). Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.

Returns the signed-in person and their dependents (usually children without their own login), each with its other guardians. A managed dependent, one with its own account or a staff link, is read-only here.

post.description: Creates a person (a child without their own login) with the signed-in person as guardian.

delete.description: Ends the signed-in person's guardianship. A dependent left without a guardian is deleted, unless it is managed (it stays); while it has bookings or class memberships, that is a 409 `in-use` and nothing changes. Anyone else's person is a 404.

put.description: Replaces the name, phone and birth date of one of the signed-in person's dependents. A managed dependent is a 409 `managed`; anyone else's person is a 404.
Replaces the signed-in person's name, phone and birth date.

get.description: Reports that the service is running and which version is deployed.
Returns one lesson the caller may see (see getSchedule). Lessons that do not exist or are not visible are reported alike as not found.
Returns all locations of the school ordered by name.

post.description: Adds a location. A name another location has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Deletes a location without rooms; one with rooms is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and address of a location. A name another location has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Returns the rooms of one location, or of all locations, ordered by name.

parameters.description: Only list the rooms of this location.
parameters.name: location

schema.description: Only list the rooms of this location.

post.description: Adds a room to a location. A name another room of the location has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`; an unknown location is a 422 on `locationId`.

delete.description: Deletes a room that no class or lesson uses; a used one is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the location, name and capacity of a room. Existing lessons keep their capacity. A name another room of the location has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Returns the lessons that start in a range of school dates, as the caller may see them. Visitors who are not signed in see public lessons that are released, plus one-off lessons and special formats, which are published early. Members also see lessons for members, and regular lessons up to visibleUntil (early access). Staff see every lesson, hidden and unreleased ones included. Canceled lessons are included with their status.

parameters.description: First school date of the range.
parameters.name: from

schema.description: First school date of the range.

parameters.description: School date after the last day of the range (exclusive); at most 42 days after from.
parameters.name: to

schema.description: School date after the last day of the range (exclusive); at most 42 days after from.

parameters.description: Only lessons with this staff member as instructor or accompanist.
parameters.name: instructor

schema.description: Only lessons with this staff member as instructor or accompanist.

parameters.description: Only lessons of this course type.
parameters.name: courseType

schema.description: Only lessons of this course type.

parameters.description: Only lessons of classes at this level; excludes one-off lessons.
parameters.name: level

schema.description: Only lessons of classes at this level; excludes one-off lessons.

get.description: Returns the school settings that are visible without signing in.
Returns the active instructors and accompanists ordered by display name.

post.description: Adds an instructor or accompanist, optionally linked to a person. An unknown person is a 422 on `personId`.

delete.description: Deletes a staff member that no class or lesson refers to; a referenced one is a 409 `in-use` and can be deactivated instead.

put.description: Replaces the name, kind, person link and active flag of a staff member. Inactive staff leave the public staff list and the schedule filters but stay on their lessons.

get.description: Returns all terms ordered by start date.

post.description: Adds a term. Terms may overlap, and their names need not be unique.

delete.description: Deletes a term without classes; a term with classes is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and dates of a term. The lessons of its classes that the new dates leave out are deleted while they lie ahead, still follow their class and have no bookings; any other lesson left out is a 422 on `startsOn` or `endsOn`, whichever leaves it out. Longer dates get the lessons that lie ahead.

get.description: Returns the weekly classes of a term ordered by weekday (Sunday first) and start time, without retired classes.
get.summary: List the classes of a term

post.description: Adds a weekly class to a term and generates its lessons that lie ahead. An unknown course type, room or staff member is a 422 on the field that names it.
